title: Luciferase Reporter Assay for NF-kB Activation
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare luciferase assay reagents
steps.instruction: Dissolve the lyophilized luciferase assay substrate in the assay buffer according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Dilute the 5X cell‑culture lysis reagent supplied in the kit to its working concentration. For a full 96‑well plate prepare 11 mL luciferase assay reagent (100 µL per sample) and 4.6 mL lysis reagent (30 µL per sample).

steps.title: Aliquot reagents into reservoirs
steps.instruction: Fill a NEST 12‑Well Reservoir with the prepared luciferase assay reagent and the diluted lysis reagent. Fill a NEST 1‑Well Reservoir with PBS for washing (50 µL per sample; 30 mL is sufficient for up to four 96‑well plates).

steps.title: Process reporter wells (Slot 2)
steps.instruction: For the reporter cell culture located on Slot 2: (1) remove the supernatant; (2) transfer 50 µL PBS from Slot 9 to each well and then remove the PBS supernatant; (3) transfer 30 µL lysis reagent from Slot 4 (Well 1) to each well and incubate 3 minutes at room temperature; (4) transfer luciferase assay reagent from Slot 4 (Well 7) to each well; (5) measure luminescence on a microplate reader (off‑deck).

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from reporter culture on Slot 2.
Add 50 µL PBS from Slot 9 to each well, then remove the PBS supernatant.
Add 30 µL lysis reagent from Slot 4 (Well 1) to each well and incubate 3 min at room temperature.
Add luciferase assay reagent from Slot 4 (Well 7) to each well.
Measure luminescence on a microplate reader (off‑deck).

steps.title: Replenish tip rack
steps.instruction: Manually replace the 300 µL tips on Slot 3.

steps.title: Repeat assay for additional slots
steps.instruction: Repeat the sequence of actions described in Step 3 for reporter cell cultures on Slots 5, 8, and 11, using PBS from Slot 9, lysis reagent from Slot 4 (Well 1), and luciferase assay reagent from Slot 4 (Wells 8, 9, 10) respectively.
